step: Alternatively, go to Settings, tap Connections, and then tap Wi-Fi.
Touch and hold the Wi-Fi icon to check your connection status.
Navigate to Settings, select your email app, then tap Storage.
Tap Clear cache.
screen: Settings > Apps > Email > Storage > Clear cache

step: Tap Clear data, and then tap OK.
screen: Settings > Apps > Email > Storage > Clear data

step: Tap Safe mode when it appears on the screen.
Swipe down from the top of the screen to open Quick settings, and then tap the Power icon.
Turn off your device and reconnect it to the appropriate charger until it is fully charged.
If the screen still fails to turn on, your device may require service.
Go to Settings > Security and privacy > Screen lock and biometrics.
screen: Settings > Security and privacy > Screen lock and biometrics

step: Connect the mouse and keyboard to your phone using a USB adapter, then navigate your device.
Tap the Search field, then enter and select Smart Switch to open the app.
On the new device, tap Receive on this phone.
Navigate to and open Settings, and then tap Advanced features.
Turn on Multi window for all apps.
screen: Settings > Advanced features > Labs > Multi window for all apps

step: From any screen, swipe left on the Edge panel, and then tap the Edit icon.
Swipe down from your mobile device's top screen and tap Smart View.
Select your TV from the list of Available devices, and then tap Start now.
Some TVs may require you to switch inputs or turn on screen mirroring.
Force a restart by pressing and holding the Power and Volume down buttons for 20 seconds.
Adjust screen orientation settings.
Press and hold the Power button, then tap Restart.
Navigate to Settings, search for and select Factory data reset, and then tap Factory data reset again.
screen: Settings > General management > Reset > Factory data reset

step: Review the information presented, then tap Reset.
Go to Settings, tap Display, and then tap the switch next to Touch sensitivity.
To turn off this feature, navigate to Settings, tap Display, and then tap the switch next to Touch sensitivity to disable it.
Go to Settings, tap Display, and then tap Navigation bar.
Select Buttons to turn off full screen gestures.
Touch and hold Power off, then tap Safe mode.
Navigate to and open Settings, then tap General management.
